name: Sigmize
author: Brainstorm Force

sections.description:
Stop guessing on your website. A/B test like the top 1% of sellers.

Sigmize gives you real user behavior data, heatmaps, session replays, and revenue tracking. All built directly into WordPress. Turn more visitors into customers without leaving your dashboard.

Why Your Website Isn’t Converting (And How to Fix It)

Most WordPress site owners rely on gut feelings to design their sites. They change headlines, test colors, adjust CTAs, but they never actually know what moves the needle. The result? Hundreds or thousands in wasted potential revenue every month.

Sigmize changes this. By combining powerful A/B testing with behavioral analytics, you’ll finally understand exactly what your visitors want and how they interact with your site.

Key Features:

Test Anything, See Everything
Create unlimited A/B tests without coding. Test page layouts, button colors, headlines, product images, etc. Sigmize’s anti-flicker technology means your visitors see smooth variations without jarring content shifts that hurt user experience.

Watch Your Customers Before They Leave
Session replays show you exactly how real users navigate your site. See where they get stuck, what confuses them, and why they abandon your cart. Fix these friction points before they cost you sales.

Visualize the Full Picture
Heatmaps reveal where users click, scroll, and engage. Scroll maps show exactly how far down the page visitors go. You’ll stop wondering what works and start seeing it.

Track Revenue, Not Just Clicks
For WooCommerce, SureCart, and Easy Digital Downloads stores: Sigmize connects your sales directly to your tests. See which variation actually increased average order value, decreased cart abandonment, or boosted conversion rates. That’s data that moves the needle.

Custom Goals That Matter to Your Business
Track what actually matters to you. Whether that’s form submissions, affiliate clicks, email signups, or page views. Define your own success metrics and watch Sigmize measure them automatically.

Whether You Run E-Commerce, Agencies, or SaaS, Sigmize Works for You

  • WooCommerce Stores: Track add-to-cart events, purchase completion, average order value per variation, and cart abandonment. Test product images, pricing, descriptions, and checkout flows.

  • SureCart & EDD Stores: Same powerful revenue tracking for digital products and subscription-based businesses.

  • Marketing Agencies: Run tests for multiple client sites. Track performance across every client project. Easy client reporting with shareable dashboards.

  • SaaS Companies: Test landing pages, signup forms, pricing pages, and feature announcements. See which messaging drives the most trial signups.

  • Content & Membership Sites: Test headlines, content structure, and call-to-action placement. Track engagement and scroll depth to understand what content resonates.
    Built for Speed and Security

Built for Speed and Security

  • Lightning-Fast Loading: Lightweight frontend code, server-side caching, and intelligent traffic distribution mean Sigmize adds zero overhead to your site.

  • Compatible Everywhere: Works with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, Gutenberg, GeneratePress, StudioPress, and any custom theme.

  • Enterprise Security: All experiments run through our secure SaaS dashboard. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Compliant with GDPR, CCPA, and WordPress.org security standards.

  • REST API for Developers: Integrate Sigmize with your favorite tools and automate workflows.

External Service Connection / Security

Sigmize connects your WordPress site with our SaaS securely. When a user initiates a connection, they are redirected to the SaaS login page. Upon clicking Connect, the SaaS generates a short-lived, single-use token which is sent back to WordPress via a redirect. WordPress then verifies the token server-to-server before storing the access token and user data for future API calls. Tokens are time-limited (1–5 minutes), single-use, and encrypted in transit using HTTPS. This ensures secure authentication, prevents token reuse, and protects user data. No actions are taken by WordPress until token verification succeeds. The access token will be used to sync A/B test experiments on the WordPress site. All privacy and data handling comply with WordPress.org Plugin Guidelines.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sigmize/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Click “Get Started Now” to connect your WordPress site
  4. Create your first experiment in the Sigmize dashboard
sections.faq:
Does Sigmize work with WooCommerce?

Yes! Sigmize has native integration with WooCommerce. Track add-to-cart events, purchase completions, conversion rates, and average order values per variation.

Can I track custom events?

Absolutely. Sigmize supports custom event tracking including page views, element clicks, scroll depth, time spent, and custom JavaScript events.

Will A/B tests cause content flicker?

No. Sigmize uses anti-flicker technology to ensure smooth variation loading without content flash.

Does it work with SureCart and Easy Digital Downloads?

Yes! Sigmize integrates with SureCart and EDD to track digital product sales, cart additions, and purchase completions.

Can I see how users interact with my site?

Yes. Use heatmaps to visualize clicks and scroll behavior, and watch session replays to see exactly how users navigate your site.

Is Sigmize compatible with page builders?

Yes. Sigmize works with all major WordPress page builders including Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, and others.

How can I report a security bug?

We take plugin security extremely seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it in a safe and responsible manner.

You can report the issue through our Bug Bounty Program. We collaborate with Patchstack to provide opportunities for researchers to report vulnerabilities. The Patchstack team will help validate, triage, and handle any reported security issues.
sections.changelog:
0.0.5 – Monday, 24th November 2025

  • Added an option to enable or disable auto-loading of the Sigmize JS SDK, allowing users to manually add it wherever required.

0.0.4 – Monday, 10th November 2025

  • UI/UX Improvements.
  • Updated e-commerce cookie duration to 10 minutes.

0.0.3 – Tuesday, 4th November 2025

  • UI/UX Improvements.

0.0.2 – Friday, 31st October 2025

  • Fixed WordPress search action and ensured A/B testing is skipped during search mode.
  • Skipped tracking goals for renewal orders to prevent duplicate conversions.

0.0.1 – Friday, 31st October 2025

  • Initial WordPress release.
  • Added support for A/B testing, heatmaps, session replays, and revenue tracking.
  • Ready for experimentation and performance analytics within WordPress sites.
